name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Sends Flight With Deportees to Venezuela for First Time Since Earthquakes
changes.summary: A plane with 147 Venezuelans landed on Monday in the South American country amid criticism over the deaths of deportees housed in a collapsed building during June’s quakes.

changes.title: A Currency Trader at Heart, Bessent Bets on Japan’s Yen
changes.summary: Coordinated intervention allowed Japan to support its currency without selling off its U.S. debt holdings.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: Inside the Democratic Socialists of America Summit
changes.summary: Our politics reporter Kellen Browning went to the Democratic Socialists of America’s national summit in Chicago to learn more about the group’s new platform.

changes.title: Trump and White House officials hope Rep. Max Miller ends reelection bid, sources say
changes.summary: President Trump and other officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits the congressional race in Ohio immediately, multiple U.S. officials familiar with the matter tell CBS News. CBS News' Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: How Well Is the Progressive Left Actually Doing?
changes.summary: Its wins have been largely confined to highly educated and heavily Democratic parts of urban America. But two races could change that.

changes.title: What’s missing from the White House plan for the future of US science
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 04 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02384-w To realize ‘a new golden age for science’, the United States needs open borders and must properly fund studies in the social sciences, public health and the humanities — not just research in technology and engineering.

changes.title: McDonald’s struggles to attract bargain-hungry customers
changes.summary: McDonald’s just reported its slowest U.S. sales growth in over a year as its value push fell flat with customers who continue to struggle with higher prices.

changes.title: Ukraine's air defenses are proving to be a weak point
changes.summary: Ukraine's defenses have held the line on most fronts, but there's one glaring weakness -- Russian ballistic missiles. Ukraine is desperately short of U.S.-made Patriot air defense missiles needed to defend against the Russians.

changes.title: A temperature dial for more realistic quantum simulations
changes.summary: Scientists from Rice University in the U.S. have developed a way to precisely tune the temperature inside a trapped-ion simulator. The breakthrough means they will be able to run quantum simulations at precise temperatures that better reflect real-world conditions.
